statement: Doing a tier list of the new plus pets; patch notes called them small bonuses but only about half to 75% are small.
Plus pets are very expensive in the shop; only worth it for the strong ones if you can trade for them or spend around $500.
Santa Snake gives +25% class EXP and +25% drop rate; he believes these are additive.
Santa Snake placed in C tier because drop rate is important but the bonus is minuscule for the price.
Frog gives 5% total damage and is additive.
Frog is straight D tier and would go lower if there were more tiers; super bad.
Purple Mushroom gives +2% gold food bonus; gold food bonus is valuable because it feeds drop rate and AFK gains.
2% gold food bonus is a drop in the ocean so Purple Mushroom goes to D tier; maybe squeaks into low C.
Sandy Pot gives +5 base all stat; being base it gets multiplied by all multipliers rather than added on top.
Sandy Pot is surprisingly decent but probably not as good as the drop rate pets.
Abacus Frog only gives tournament power and does nothing for account gains.
Abacus Frog is not great for account gains.
Board Bean gives 3% AFK gains rate.
Board Bean is a good stat and okay if you are early game but not great; lands in C tier.
Crystal Custard gives 30% drop rate and class EXP; same as Santa Snake but slightly better; C tier.
Ram gives +30% carry capacity.
Carry capacity is surprisingly good because it helps with golden food which increases drop rate; AFK gains; class XP and coin income.
Carry capacity is hard to come by; the biggest sources are pets and the guild; guild is a true multi.
Ram is so good he is considering S tier but placing him in A for now.
Squirrel gives +0.25x kills; it is a multi.
Kills are always welcome for opening portals and death notes; Squirrel is small but solid; B tier.
Clammy is the same kind of bonus as Sans the Skeleton and Custard and is additive; stays in C tier.
Dude gives +0.25x divinity point gains.
Dude is probably not as good as kills but divinity week is on; deserves at least B tier.
A pet gives 3% all skill efficiency and is probably additive.
Skill efficiency pet is not as good as drop rate; bottom of C tier or even D tier.
A frog with total damage is judged slightly better than the other total damage pet; fair placement.
Smoke Devil gives 50x jade gain; 20x ninja stealth and 0.75 sneaky EXP.
Smoke Devil is strong for early to mid game but its niche is useless after a certain point.
Jade gain is not that useful because there is already plenty; but it could let you race through the mechanic and gain masteries.
20x ninja stealth is pretty good; Smoke Devil goes at the bottom of B tier.
Puffer Blob gives 25% meritocracy bonus multi; his meritocracy is currently at 350%.
Meritocracy is one of the strongest mechanics and part of the primary meta; Puffer Blob is top of S tier.
Meritocracy gives months if not years worth of gains on certain weeks.
Hive Mind gives 25% Prisma bubble multi; his Prisma multiplier is currently 3.26 without the pet.
Hive Mind also gives plus two Prisma bonuses which reportedly do not work currently.
Hive Mind is easy S tier and slightly better than Puffer Blob's meritocracy; alchemy has long been among the strongest mechanics.
Crystal Glonco gives 0.25x damage; 0.2x class XP; 0.15x drop rate and 0.1 extra kills; all multi.
Crystal Glonco is A tier; Ram beats it very slightly because of carry capacity rarity; the two are close.
Bubba gives 20% gallery bonus multi; his gallery bonus is around 2x and some change.
Gallery is hands down the strongest mechanic; Bubba is better than alchemy pet and goes top of S tier.
Pig gives 0.5x friend bonus and one friend bonus slot; the only extra bonus he has is from the event.
Pig does not beat Dude because divinity is a powerful multi for endgame with extra class EXP and talent points; Pig is mid B tier.
Ones to want are A and S tier; B tier is nice to have but not worth the expense unless gifted.
Ram moved to S tier because carry capacity is hard to get; 30% is worth maybe a thousand drop rate plus other benefits.
S tier: Ram; Puffer Blob for meritocracy multi; Hive Mind for Prisma multi; Bubba for gallery multi.
20% gallery multi is worth thousands of drop rate plus class XP and AFK gains; a 5% version would not be worth the price.
Extra Prisma bubbles are scarce; especially if you missed the pay-to-win event; making Hive Mind nuts.
Four S tier pets give humongous gains to accounts.
